name: ai-coding-os-monorepo
description: AI Coding OS core knowledge-network Skill Suite with a co-located experimental Goal Proof CLI.

scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter goal-proof typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun run --filter goal-proof test && bun test scripts
scripts.check:goal-proof-experiment: python3 experiments/goal-proof/scripts/self_check.py && bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.check: bun run check:core && bun run check:goal-proof-experiment
scripts.bundle:skills: mkdir -p dist && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && AUDIT=dist/ai-coding-os-skill-suite-$VERSION.audit.json && python3 skills/tooling/suite_audit.py --suite skills --out $AUDIT && python3 skills/tooling/build_suite_release.py --repo . --audit $AUDIT --out-dir dist
